provenance: Telephone call, 2026-09-03, Larry's son asking the tier-1 questions from the interview guide and typing Larry's answers as he spoke them. The Camp Zama date question had been promoted to the head of the guide that morning. Raw capture: research/interviews/breakfast-questions.md, annotated in place under each question.
text: Zukowski. I don't know the first name. No one went by first name in the military.
researchNotes: Asked to spell the name himself. He gives ZUKOWSKI, which makes this the third rendering in the archive carrying Larry's own authority, after "Ton Son Nuht" and "Geutler". The earlier "Zekeowski" was his son's transcription of the sound and should now be treated as superseded for search purposes, though not deleted. The remark about first names is worth keeping as a general caution: it explains why so many of the men in this archive are surnames only.
